history.text: The Kingdom of Burundi developed under a ruling mwami.
The territory came under German control, then Belgian administration after 1916.
Independence came on 1 July, initially as a monarchy.
The monarchy was abolished and a republic declared.
Civil war followed the assassination of the first elected president.
The Arusha framework brought power-sharing and elections.

worthSeeing.title: Lake Tanganyika shore:
worthSeeing.text: Beaches and fishing villages along the world's second-deepest lake, at Bujumbura.

worthSeeing.title: Kibira National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Montane rainforest along the Congo-Nile divide, home to chimpanzees.

worthSeeing.title: Karera Falls:
worthSeeing.text: A set of falls in the southeast, reached through wooded hills.
